prompt: Classify the requested shadow lift. A: a small positive lift of shadows. B: a noticeable or strong positive lift of shadows. C: another edit, no edit, unspecified strength, or conflicting request. Preserving highlights can accompany A or B. Choose one letter A, B, or C.

instructions.zh: 请把背景里的路人移除。
instructions.en: Remove the person in the background.

instructions.zh: 加一点棕褐色的复古色调。
instructions.en: Add a subtle brown sepia tone.

instructions.zh: 把整张照片的曝光明显提高。
instructions.en: Raise the exposure of the whole photograph noticeably.

instructions.zh: 显著压暗阴影，保持高光。
instructions.en: Darken the shadows noticeably, preserving highlights.

instructions.zh: 把暗部提亮，亮部原样保留。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows and keep the highlights unchanged.

instructions.zh: 暗部只提一点点，但同一处暗部也要大幅提亮。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows a little, but also lift the same shadows substantially.

instructions.zh: 明显提亮阴影，不要提亮高光。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows noticeably, but do not brighten the highlights.

method: Freeze the local Qwen2.5-VL-7B base, text only, on CPU float32. Use highest next-token logit among A/B/C after the chat prompt. Same thirty-two held literal texts with no reference output or pixels sent to the base. Then apply A/B to the already frozen R27 presets and pixel ranker, C abstains. Compare with fixed R27 result. New control rows are text checks only, not image-quality evidence. No adapter fitting or threshold tuning.
